text:
I fixed six bugs in `catalog/`, but I couldn't run `python3 -m unittest` because I don't have a shell here. Please run it to confirm everything passes. I checked each fix against its test by reading the code, and didn't change any tests.

- `fees.py`: the fee added the daily rate to the days late instead of multiplying, so it's now `days_late * DAILY_FEE`.
- `inventory.py`: `recent(n)` returned one event too many. It's now `_history[-n:]`, and returns an empty list when `n` is 0 or less.
- `search.py`: it imported from a module that doesn't exist (`catalog.nonexistent`). It now imports from `catalog.text`.
- `members.py`: the borrowing limit was 3, but the comment and tests say five, so it's now `MAX_BORROWED = 5`.
- `books.py`: `parse_book` left the year as text, so `age()` didn't work. It now converts it with `int(year)`.
- `factory.py`: `sample_books()` was missing the third book. I added `Book("Emma", "Austen", 1815, 1)`; the author, year and copy count are my choice, since the tests only check the title.
